summary: Iteration 5 tested against the public URL. Backend regression suite passed 30/30, including new precise 5-second billing tests for finalize-preview and direct end. Desktop 1920x900 and tablet 900x800 modal layout passed: modal stayed within 90vh, split rows appeared, single-method controls hid, and frozen total/confirm footer remained visible. Split-payment UI submission still fails with HTTP 400 because frontend sends payment_method='split'. Auth playbook checks also found missing application cookies, wildcard non-credentialed CORS, no brute-force lockout, and non-updating admin seed.

critical.issue: Does not set application access/refresh httpOnly cookies; only the Cloudflare infrastructure cookie is present. Authentication remains bearer token in localStorage.
No brute-force lockout: six consecutive failures for a valid-format email all returned 401, and MongoDB has no login_attempts collection/index.

minor.issue: Returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with allow_credentials=False instead of explicit frontend origin plus credential support.
Existing admin password hash is never reconciled with ADMIN_PASSWORD; seed only creates a missing account.

ui_bugs.issue: Balanced split payment submission returns HTTP 400 and remains on the modal because endSession sends payment_method='split', which backend rejects before processing payments[].

integration_issues.issue: Reproduced at 900x800 with ₹120 rounded total split Cash ₹60 + UPI ₹60: UI showed Balanced, POST /end returned 400, and no Bill navigation occurred.

action_items: Fix split contract mismatch: send a valid concrete payment_method (for example payments[0].method) or condition backend validation on payments[] being absent; backend already derives stored payment_method='split'.

Implement auth playbook requirements: secure httpOnly access/refresh cookies, cookie-aware auth/logout, explicit credentialed CORS, five-attempt lockout with MongoDB index, and seed reconciliation of changed admin password.
Retest balanced split submission through Bill page after the contract fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Sessions.jsx endSession line 57 still sends the unsupported literal 'split'; this is the direct RCA for the UI failure.
Precise session formula is correctly shared in computeBill and correctly uses seconds/3600 on both backend paths.

Frame completion and auto-close billing still truncate to whole minutes at server.py lines 634-636 and 773-775; if precise billing is expected for frame-based sessions too, short frames remain undercharged.
Login.jsx calls navigate during render (line 20), producing React 'Cannot update BrowserRouter while rendering Login' console warnings.
server.py is ~1400 lines and exceeds the 700-line review threshold; split routes/models/helpers into focused modules.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (layout and precise display pass at both viewports; split submission fails)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ sessions and temporary snack orders through API/UI; all active test sessions were ended. Staff permissions reset to manage_sessions=true only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Precise 5-second preview/direct-end tests pass around ₹0.42 at ₹300/hr. Modal geometry: desktop 512x810 within 90vh and tablet 512x720 within 90vh; footer remained on-screen after split expansion. Add a snack before split UI testing so rounded total is >=2 and two positive methods can be entered.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend endSession constructs payment_method as 'split' for multiple payments, while backend validates payment_method against cash/upi/card/bank/credit before inspecting payments. Auth deviations are implementation gaps visible in server.py: bearer-only HTTPBearer dependency, wildcard CORS with credentials disabled, no login-attempt persistence, and create-only seeding.
